title: Azure Security Baseline & Governance (Least-Privilege, Secure Config, Guardrails)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Azure governance: Azure Policy guardrails, least-privilege RBAC, secure-config baseline, Defender for Cloud; multi-service, org-wide).
hook: Put guardrails on Azure — secure configuration, least privilege, and policy that enforces itself
problem: An Azure subscription without governance drifts fast: over-privileged owners, public storage, unencrypted resources, and no consistent baseline — exactly what Defender for Cloud and auditors flag. This solution gives you a repeatable Azure security baseline and governance: Azure Policy guardrails that prevent and audit misconfiguration, least-privilege RBAC, a secure-configuration baseline, and Defender for Cloud to measure and improve secure posture continuously.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Azure governance model (management groups, Azure Policy initiatives, RBAC least-privilege), the secure-configuration baseline, and Defender for Cloud secure score / regulatory compliance.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (an Azure subscription/tenant, Entra ID, Owner/Policy contributor rights, a governance/scope design, Defender for Cloud plan, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define scope (management groups/subscriptions), assign Azure Policy guardrail initiatives (audit then deny), tighten RBAC to least privilege, apply the secure-config baseline, enable Defender for Cloud and remediate top findings, validate, pilot, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — Azure policy/RBAC/secure-config discovery, compliance and least-privilege validation, a governance posture and drift report, safe remediation of over-privilege/misconfig, and a scope/management-group targeting helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable Azure security baseline and governance — Azure Policy guardrails, least-privilege RBAC, a secure-configuration baseline, and Defender for Cloud to measure and improve posture continuously. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
